effective_or_revised: Original Effective Date 03/15/10; Reviewed 09/25/25; Revised 01/01/26 (23 pages)
sections_in_order: Header block (policy number, Original Effective Date, Reviewed, Revised)
criteria_location: Position Statement ~80 lines: five paragraph-level rulings (AxiaLIF investigational; open SI joint fusion covered for 4 indications; minimally invasive SI fusion with a 9-item ALL list; posterior/intra-articular SI approaches investigational; annular repair devices investigational). Description (230 lines) and References (530 lines) are evidence review.
procedures_covered: Axial lumbosacral interbody fusion, AxiaLIF (22586, investigational)
Minimally invasive SI joint fusion (27278 investigational, 27279)

logic.top_level: pathways: open SI fusion = any of 4 indications; minimally invasive SI fusion = ALL of ~9 criteria with nested ALL/any sub-lists; others investigational

k_of_n.quote: There is a positive response to a cluster of 3 provocative tests (eg, thigh thrust test, compression test, Gaenslen sign, distraction test, Patrick test, or posterior provocation test)

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Inline: 'There is an absence of generalized pain behavior (eg, somatoform disorder) or generalized pain disorders (eg, fibromyalgia)'; imaging must exclude 'destructive lesions (eg, tumor, infection) or inflammatory arthropathy'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Has undergone and failed a minimum 6 months of intensive nonoperative treatment that must include all of the following:
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Embedded 'all of' inside a bullet that is itself one ALL item; the bullet's final sub-bullet ends with ', AND' that belongs to the outer list.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Pain is at least 5 on a 0 to 10 rating scale; and pain impacts quality of life or limits activities of daily living, AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Lowercase 'and' inside the bullet and uppercase AND at the end serve different roles.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Minimally invasive sacroiliac joint fusion/stabilization using a posterior (dorsal) approach and/or using an intra-articular implant(s) ... is considered experimental or investigational.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' makes the investigational condition either approach alone.

requirement_kinds.quote: Pain is at least 5 on a 0 to 10 rating scale
Participation in at least 6 weeks of active physical therapy targeted at the lumbar spine, pelvis, sacroiliac joint, and hip
Imaging of the pelvis (anteroposterior plain radiograph) rules out concomitant hip pathology
at least a 75% reduction in pain for the expected duration of the anesthetic used following an image-guided, contrast-enhanced intra-articular sacroiliac joint injection on 2 separate occasions
A tumor involving the sacrum and/or sacroiliac joint
A trial of a therapeutic sacroiliac joint injection (ie, corticosteroid injection) has been performed at least once
using a U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved implant
Evaluation and appropriate management of associated cognitive, behavioral, or addiction issues, if any

thresholds.quote: Pain is at least 5 on a 0 to 10 rating scale
at least a 75% reduction in pain

time_windows.quote: a minimum 6 months of intensive nonoperative treatment
at least 6 weeks of active physical therapy

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Codes carry inline '(investigational)' tags for 22586, 27278, 63032, C9757; covered ones (27279, 27280) untagged. Tag is the only mapping from code to ruling.

external_dependencies.quote: using a U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved implant

external_dependencies.what: Product lists in Other are illustrative
external_dependencies.quote: The use of specific product names is illustrative only.

vague_terms.quote: Imaging of the sacroiliac joint indicates evidence of injury and/or degeneration

extraction_hazards: Bullets are either the private-use character U+F0B7 or U+2022 depending on the document (the fusion guideline uses both), never '-' or '*'; nested bullets use other glyphs ('o') or only deeper indentation
Hyperlink navigation bar after the disclaimer is flattened into a 2-3 row text block that looks like headings
Form-feed (\f) page breaks can fall mid-list or immediately before a section heading, so '^HEADING' regexes can miss; no running headers/footers or page numbers to strip
Second-level bullets lose their glyph and appear only as extra indentation
Brand-name device list inside a sentence (dorsal-approach devices) and a second device list in OTHER could be mistaken for covered devices
Very long (23 page) document: Description and References are 70% of text
Update history records that bracing was removed as a requirement in 06/15/18, yet the current text lists Bracing among the nonoperative treatments -- history and body are not guaranteed consistent
interesting_structures: Multi-paragraph position statement mixing covered, conditional and investigational rulings; later paragraphs carve down earlier ones ('all other conditions')
Diagnostic injection response (75% relief twice) as a criterion
Procedure code investigational flags in coding table drive part of the ruling

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Dense but regular ALL-of tree for the one real criteria block; trouble is separating the five rulings and two-level bullets.
